steps.assistant_text: agent-g run 392: re-decode from the USO reloc table. The function initialises THREE separate 0x40-byte BSS records (sym1520 / 1542 / 1544), one per unrolled region, not one record. Each region: Save65EE4 *s = &record; if (s != 0) {} (cfront this==0 style test that uopt folds for a global address; the leftover block structure keeps the pointer uncoloured so every access re-materialises lui like the target), then base / data / size / end stores, f662E8(s, B + 4, s->data), block-scoped base temporaries for calls 2 and 3 (a1 loaded first), f8 / fC reads through f66210, f34 = 0, successor f6612C(s). Each region sits on ONE source line: as1 schedules jal delay slots by source line (per-statement lines give 21 differing words). In-unit callees go through blank aliases pinned to 0.
